text:
sophia_ray: FYI — EnterpriseHealth asked for a multi-site air-gapped POC. Key asks: USB/SSD delivery, incremental deltas only, signed manifests, a deterministic upgrade cadence they can lock into procurement, and a per-site multi-year pricing table (including renewal discounts). They also want explicit rollback SLAs and confirmation we can provide binary diffs for their custom quantized models.

omar_elias: TL;DR: we can do signed delta bundles + manifest verification. Caveats: delta efficiency varies by shard format; some custom quantized shards may need full replacement. Agent minimum for delta apply = 2.6.0. We'll include a fallback flag that forces full-bundle if diff ratio > threshold.

helena_vu: Ops/acceptance notes:
- apply (on-site): `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --verify --apply-mode=delta`
- rollback: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/previous-manifest.json --verify --rollback`
- we produce: manifest.json, manifest.sig (base64), checksums.txt (sha256), and custody.log for packaged media.
- delta verification will run a dry-run checksum compare before write; if mismatch -> abort with non-zero exit and logfile.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-17234 assigned to omar_elias. Link: https://app.redwood/POC-17234

sophia_ray: Pricing ask from customer: 3-year table with per-site price floors, optional monthly cadence, and emergency hotfix SLA. Can we give a clear matrix? Also they asked if we can cap liability for physical media loss in the SOW.

omar_elias: Pricing proposal (sales guidance):
- Baseline offline (3-year commit) = $13k/yr/site (quarterly deltas, signed manifests, standard custody logs)
- Quarterly -> included. Monthly cadence SLA = +$6k/yr/site.
- Emergency hotfix (48h) = +$4k/yr/site or per-event $5k.
- Full-image only delivery (no delta) = +$9k/yr/site.
- Multi-site volume discount: 10% off for 10-24 sites, 18% off for 25+ on 3-year commit.
Note: travel/logistics & courier insurance billed T&M.

contracts_max: Legal/contract asks: we need to include an offline-deliverables appendix with: acceptance tests (checksums + signature verification), rollback SLA steps, custody chain disposition, and liability cap for physical loss (we usually cap at cost of media + one-year fee unless customer requests higher). Also need a clause describing how SBOMs are accepted and retained. I can draft.

helena_vu: Demo manifest example (trimmed) for kickoff:
```
{
  "manifest_version":"1.0",
  "site_id":"enterprisehealth-west",
  "bundles":["runtime-4.2.zst","models/custom-quant-v1"],
  "delta":true,
  "delta_meta":{"format":"patch.v1","base_version":"2026-01-10"},
  "checksums":"checksums.txt",
  "sig":"MIIBIjANBgkqh...",
  "apply_instructions":"See README_USM.txt"
}
```

sophia_ray: Customer procurement also wants a sample SOW clause that states cadence locked to contract (either quarterly or monthly) and explicit sign-off before each apply. They also asked whether we can pre-sign deltas for them to stash in an internal vault and whether we support customer-provided signing keys.

omar_elias: We support both: we can sign with Redwood KMS by default, or we can perform HSM/PKCS#11 signing using customer keys (they provide public cert or HSM endpoint). If they want pre-signed artifacts we can export the manifest.sig produced during packaging. For vaulting, we can provide a signed artifact bundle with timestamp and custody log.

contracts_max: I'll prepare two SOW language options: (A) Redwood-signed artifacts (standard liability cap), and (B) Customer-signed artifacts (we accept but waive media liability; need key exchange process documented). Also will include acceptance test steps (signature verify, checksums, smoke-run inference).

helena_vu: Acceptance checklist we plan to run on-site post-apply:
1) verify `manifest.sig` with provided root cert
2) compare `checksums.txt` for all bundles
3) dry-run apply (no write) -> exit code 0
4) actual apply -> run `curl localhost:8080/health` and sample generation test
5) collect `apply.log` + append to custody.log and send signed copy to Redwood via approved channel.

eng-sales-bot: Reminder: scheduled kickoff call Wed 14:00 PT. Please confirm attendees.

sophia_ray: I'll invite procurement + security. omar, can you prepare a signed demo delta and a README with "bring-your-media" steps by Tue EOD?

omar_elias: Yes — I'll produce a small signed delta, checksums, custody.log sample and upload to staging. ETA Tue EOD.

contracts_max: I'll draft the SOW appendix + two contract options and drop before the call.

sophia_ray: Perfect. If they can share their root cert/key exchange preference before the call we can demo end-to-end verification. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
